author: (Anton, 1838)

note.en: A small purse oyster that hides under rock and rubble and on pilings; five museum samples including one from the Cahuita jetty. Easily mistaken for the bicolor purse oyster.
note.es: Una ostra bolsa pequeña que se esconde bajo rocas y escombros y en pilotes; cinco muestras de museo, una de ellas del muelle de Cahuita. Se confunde fácilmente con la ostra bolsa bicolor.

evidence: GBIF: 5 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica (REGAMA and Cahuita catalogue), Avicennia
